title: Qualify immutable published dw.quantities binary with isolated Ubuntu WSL Linux net11 consumer
commitMessage: test: qualify published Math quantities binary on Linux net11

contribution.summary: Qualify the unchanged published dw.quantities net10 DLL in a source-free Linux x64 net11/C#15 NuGet consumer.
contribution.value: Verify the RS137 archive and DLL hashes from NUGET_LOCAL, copy only the immutable archive into a disposable isolated feed, restore an exact PackageReference with Linux SDK11, compile/run canonical exact arithmetic and refusal tests, then rehash both original and snapshot. No feed writes or publication.
debtChanges: RS245 succeeded first-pass attempt 001, qualifying immutable dw.quantities binary parity in independent Windows net10 and net11 consumers.
RS246 extends this package-only boundary to Ubuntu WSL Linux x64 net11; it does not certify dependent packages, broad Math APIs or M8 readiness.
contribution.nextAction: Qualify exact dependent published Math package graphs and their independent Windows/Linux binary consumers before a production migration decision.
